headline: Sierra Leone: agreement with IMF paves the way for 78.2 million dollars in financing
summary: Sierra Leone has reached a staff-level agreement with the IMF on the fourth review of its Extended Credit Facility and the first review of the Resilience and Sustainability Facility. The outcome could unlock $78.2 million in financing.
why: The IMF provides balance-of-payments and budget support to low-income countries, and its staff-level agreements are typically prerequisites for board approval and disbursements.
original_headline: Sierra Leone : un accord avec le FMI ouvre la voie à 78,2 millions de dollars de financements
